p: he tear my soul like a: He desires God to deliver him from the rage of cruel Saul.
this: With which Cush charges me.
If I have rewarded evil unto: If I did not reverence Saul for affinities sake, and preserved his life, 1Sa 26:8,9.
honour in the dust: Let me not only die, but be dishonoured forever.
judgment that thou hast commanded: In promising me the kingdom.
return thou on high: Not only for mine, but for your Church's sake declare your power.
righteousness: As concerning my behaviour towards Saul and my enemies.
hearts and reins: Though they pretend a just cause against me, yet God will judge their hypocrisy.
every day: He continually calls the wicked to repentance by some sign of his judgments.
he turn not: Unless Saul changes his mind, I will die, for he has both the men and weapons to destroy me. Thus considering his great danger, he magnifies God's grace.
righteousness: In faithfully keeping his promise to me.
